pages.title: Finding Astral Silver
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 40 to 140. Veins target up to 6 blocks, with 7 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 3.

pages.title: Working Astral Silver
pages.text: Smelt Astral Silver Ore or Astral Silver Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 523 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 3.$(br)Mining efficiency: 8.5.$(br)Material damage bonus: 2.8.$(br)Enchantability: 36.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 4, leggings 3, boots 2.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.0.$(br)Enchantability: 36.

pages.title: Armor: Starlight
pages.text: Gives Night Vision and Speed depending on how many pieces of armor are worn, effects are only applied when the player is directly under the night-sky or in The End.

pages.title: Weapon: Extraterrestrial
pages.text: 45% more damage if the player is in another dimension

pages.title: Tool: Extraterrastrial
pages.text: Increased speed when breaking blocks in dimensions that aren't the Overworld
